title: Validate Strict ISO 8601 UTC Timestamps
explanation: Validates standardized UTC and timezone-offset timestamp representations (e.g. 2026-09-30T10:15:30Z or 2026-09-30T15:45:00+05:30) with optional millisecond fractions.
caveat: Validates format structure only; it will not catch impossible calendar dates like February 31st. For full calendar logic, pair with date-fns or native Date validation.
